series.$description: Categorical series colours by the golden-angle rule: colour n = oklch(series.lightness series.chroma, series.hue + n × series.step). Angles are degrees, written as plain numbers. The CSS composes the colour; a token file cannot compute it.

step.$description: The golden angle in degrees: no hue repeats, and neighbours sit about 137 degrees apart.

chroma.$description: Fixed chroma, so every series has the same semi-muted weight.

chroma-vivid.$description: Twice the chroma, for a mark that is not data, such as the slice icons in the Storybook sidebar. Never for a chart: series of data keep the semi-muted weight.
